title: Glitch lab (source of the Glitch pack)
summary: The comps every Glitch template was built and verified in: RGB split title, slice shift, noise bars overlay and glitch cut.
use_when: You want to see a glitch pattern working before using it, copy its keys into an edgy job, or re-extract a template after changing it.

comps: GL RGB title (90 f, two drop shadows)
GL Slice shift (75 f, 5 masked slices)
GL Glitch cut (30 f, stand-in scenes)

carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27

fonts: Rethink Sans ExtraBold (install it: Google Fonts, SIL OFL)

copy_notes: Masks: each band is the mask; mask.make takes the FIRST id as the mask.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/glitch_lab.py (seeded random), then PRESETS and MASKS, edit.save.
Every comp lints 0/0; qc at 240 px finds no flashes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
